findings: ROOT CAUSE confirmed at combat-bridge.js:72 — `if (e.utility_class === null || e.geometry !== 'none') dmg += outputOf(...)`. That predicate is true for every effect with geometry, i.e. every enemy-side effect. Now closed over DAMAGE_EFFECTS (5) only.

The build had NO quest runtime: QuestBook/FactionGates/QuestEngine (1155 lines, complete) were never instantiated and game/data/quests/hooks.json never existed. That is why AR-2 B7 was not_run and RI-MAG04 M6=0/M7=0. Now instantiated at engine._boot.
QuestEngine.context() gated `requires.spell_effects` on magic.knownEffects (a spell you OWN). Changed to magic.castEffects (an effect you have actually CAST) — RI-MAG06's premise applied to the gate.

No S11 buildup meter existed anywhere in game/src (grep 'buildup' -> 2 hits, both comments). Added BUILDUP in magic/apply.js with per-kind integer thresholds; paralyse is magnitude x4 per contact against a threshold of 100, so the cheapest paralyse spell needs 3 contacts and 0->applied-in-one-frame is structurally impossible.

No mitigation path existed: resolve.js computed damage and applied it with no multiplier. Added mitigate(B, dmg) at the single site damage is computed, consuming body.mitigation, body.armourRating and body.wardCharges.

Levitation: altitude was a counter with a Focus tax; pos[1] was never written. stepLevitation now assigns b.pos[1] = groundY + altitude, and a new _levitationLocomotion branch in combat/player.js caps drift at the declared 1.4 m/s with no sprint/jog ladder. _tryStart drops the five denied buttons from cast-classes.json §levitation.airborne_denies.
Projectile tracking measured 0.000 deg/s because _spawnProjectile never set p.target. Now acquires a body already inside a 20-degree release cone and stops dead at cutoffF.
Data loader keys game/data/quests/* by doc.id, not filename: hooks.json -> data.quests['quest-hooks'], magic-utility.json -> data.quests['magic-utility-quests'].
api-probe 33/33 PASS with all of the above wired.

CONCURRENT-AGENT HAZARD: other agents commit the whole worktree (commit 1c1f98b picked up my in-flight files) and left engine.js referencing a missing _censusStep. I added a defensive `this._censusStep ? ... : null` guard on that line.
next_step: write tools/harness/mag-census.mjs (RI-MAG06 instrument), measure EFFECT-FUNCTION and HP_DAMAGE_ONLY live, then VFX and the economy
notes_for_successor: The registry in game/src/sim/magic/apply.js is checked for completeness at boot (assertRegistryComplete): a catalogue effect with no handler throws rather than falling through to a damage number. DAMAGE_EFFECTS is the frozen 5-element set shared by apply.js and combat-bridge.js so the two cannot drift.
